mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding a 0.2 percentage point increase over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, the 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 700000, the 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Expansionary industrial production (INDPRO) growth signals a strengthening supply chain and manufacturing sector, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% per month, the 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A growing labor force (PAYEMS) indicates expanding economic activity and rising corporate hiring, which supports consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS predicting 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1250 units signals weakening residential construction and consumer confidence, which negatively affects the broader economy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1250, the 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicate a monetary tightening cycle that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, the 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic growth (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized) reflects robust aggregate demand and corporate profitability, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized, the 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
